items.rationale: Physical surge damage is established and the appliance falls under 2.3.3, well within the EUR 5,000 sub-limit. No evidence is given about the surge protector, so no 50% reduction is applied. The price level follows the earlier surge cases, where the speaker came out below about 336.
Under 7.1.8(b), delivery of replacement property to the insured location is not a repair cost, so t = 0.
Under 7.1.8(c), installing and commissioning replacement property is not indemnified, so t = 0.

The TV is a surge-damaged appliance under 2.3.3 and is within the sub-limit. No reduction is applied because nothing is established about the surge protector, and indemnity is capped at standard-grade replacement under 7.1.9. The price follows the earlier TV reference of about 517 to 616.

items.rationale: This is a property and liability arrangement charge. 3.1.4, 3.1.5 and 7.1.8(f) exclude it, so t = 0.

items.rationale: This is an order-placement charge under a service or liability arrangement. 7.1.8(f) excludes it, so t = 0.
Under 7.1.8(d), an attendance charge is only payable when the work on the same invoice is indemnifiable. This invoice contains no indemnifiable work, so t = 0.
